title: Create: Yappadium
description: A Create based Modpack with alot of Performance upgrades!
body:
###  A Create based Modpack with alot of Performance upgrades!

If you have seen Yappadium itself you know it is a good performance modpack, i used Yappadium for the base of this modpack

Mods included:
- QoL mods
- Create (With alot of Addons)
- Farmers Delight
- Comforts
- Chipped
- Animal feeding through
- Sophisticated Backpacks
- Immersive aircraft
- Compasses
- Storage mods
- Create: Resource packs!


**Important message:**

Do not Update Nvidium (Neoforge) and JEI, this will crash you're game.

Only updating this modpack when Create is updated to newer versions of Minecraft OR Create itself!
